"О награждении медалью ордена "За заслуги перед Отечеством" II степени"</ref>
*[[Medal "For Strengthening of Brotherhood in Arms"]] (Ministry of Defense) (2001).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kommersant.ru/doc/169440|script-title=ru:Депутаты Госдумы получили к празднику медали и погоны|date=23 February 2001|language=ru|access-date=28 February 2015|archive-date=2 April 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402135835/http://www.kommersant.ru/doc/169440|url-status=live}}</ref>
*[[Order of Holy Prince Daniel of Moscow]] ([[Russian Orthodox Church|ROC]]) (1996) – for his contribution to nation-building.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://severleg.cwx.ru/?tag=boris-nemcov |title=Boris Nemtsov |date=5 April 2009 |work=severleg.cwx.ru |access-date=28 February 2015 |archive-date=10 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210110222237/http://severleg.cwx.ru/?tag=boris-nemcov |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aif.ru/dontknows/file/1457284|title=Чем запомнился Борис Немцов?|publisher=aif.ru|date=28 February 2015|access-date=28 February 2015|archive-date=1 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150301113704/http://www.aif.ru/dontknows/file/1457284|url-status=live}}</ref>
*Honorary sign of the Legislative Assembly of [[Nizhny Novgorod Region]] "Merit" (26 March 2009).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.niann.ru/?id=347822|title=Валерий Шанцев, Евгений Люлин, Борис Немцов, Евгений Крестьянинов, Владимир Иванов и Дмитрий Бедняков будут награждены почетным знаком Заксобрания Нижегородской области "За заслуги"|publisher=niann.ru|date=26 March 2009|access-date=28 February 2015|archive-date=18 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150318142444/http://niann.ru/?id=347822|url-status=live}}</ref>
*[[Order of Prince Yaroslav the Wise]], Fifth class, ([[Ukraine]]) (19 August 2006) – for a significant contribution to the development of international cooperation, strengthening the authority and positive image of Ukraine in the world, popularization of its historical and modern achievements.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.president.gov.ua/ru/documents/4873.html |title=Указ Президента Украины No 698/2006 |publisher=president.gov.ua |access-date=28 February 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140808044054/http://www.president.gov.ua/ru/documents/4873.html |archive-date=8 August 2014 |df=dmy-all }}</ref>
* [[Order of Liberty (Ukraine)|Order of Liberty]] (Ukraine, posthumously).<ref name=Kommersant_Order>{{cite news|title=Петр Порошенко посмертно наградил Бориса Немцова орденом Свободы|url=http://www.kommersant.ru/doc/2678842|agency=[[Kommersant]]|date=3 March 2015|access-date=3 March 2015|archive-date=6 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150306172814/http://www.kommersant.ru/doc/2678842|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[Jan Karski Eagle Prize]] (Poland, 15 May 2015, posthumously).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tvn24.pl/wiadomosci-ze-swiata,2/nagroda-orla-jana-karskiego-dla-borysa-niemcowa,542678.html|title=Żanna Niemcowa: mój ojciec oddał życie za wolną Rosję|publisher=[[TVN24]]|language=pl|date=15 May 2015|access-date=15 May 2015|archive-date=18 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150518082242/http://www.tvn24.pl/wiadomosci-ze-swiata,2/nagroda-orla-jana-karskiego-dla-borysa-niemcowa,542678.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[IRI Freedom Award]] (United States, September 2015, posthumously).<ref name=FAH>{{cite web|title=Freedom Award Honorees|url=http://www.iri.org/freedom-award-honorees|access-date=10 September 2015|archive-date=7 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150907025050/http://www.iri.org/freedom-award-honorees|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Борису Немцову посмертно присуждена "Премия свободы" в США|url=http://www.bbc.com/russian/rolling_news/2015/09/150910_rn_nemtsov_liberty_award|agency=[[BBC]]|date=10 September 2015|access-date=10 September 2015|archive-date=11 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150911042611/http://www.bbc.com/russian/rolling_news/2015/09/150910_rn_nemtsov_liberty_award|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=IRI to Honor Speaker Boehner, Mo Ibrahim & Boris Nemtsov with 2015 Freedom Award|date=27 July 2015 |url=http://www.iri.org/resource/iri-honor-speaker-boehner-mo-ibrahim-boris-nemtsov-2015-freedom-award|publisher=[[International Republican Institute]]|access-date=10 September 2015|archive-date=8 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908014031/http://www.iri.org/resource/iri-honor-speaker-boehner-mo-ibrahim-boris-nemtsov-2015-freedom-award|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[Boris Nemtsov Square, Prague|Boris Nemtsov Square]] (Czech Republic, 27 February 2020, posthumously)
* Boris Nemtsov Place (United Kingdom, 14 November 2022, posthumously) – [[Camden London Borough Council|Camden Council]] named a roundabout in [[Highgate]] "Boris Nemtsov Place", very close to the Russian Trade Delegation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Highgate roundabout officially becomes ‘Boris Nemtsov Place' |url=https://www.camdennewjournal.co.uk/article/highgate-roundabout-officially-becomes-boris-nemtsov-place |access-date=2026-05-28 |website=Camden New Journal |language=en-gb}}</ref>

==Political publications==
Memoirs:
*"Provincial" – 1997
*"Provincial in Moscow" – 1999
* [[Confessions of a rebel]] – 2007
Beginning in 2008, Nemtsov and [[Vladimir Milov]] published several [[white paper]]s criticising Putin's government and proposing alternative ways of development for the country:
*''Putin. Results'' – February 2008{{citation needed|date=March 2015}}
*''Putin and Gazprom'' – September 2008{{citation needed|date=March 2015}}
*''Putin and the Crisis'' – February 2009{{citation needed|date=March 2015}}
*''Sochi and the Olympics'' – April 2009{{citation needed|date=March 2015}}
*''Putin. Results. 10 years'' – June 2010,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.putin-itogi.ru/doklad/ |title=Putin. Results. 10 years. 2010, putin-itogi.ru |access-date=28 February 2015 |archive-date=17 October 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121017052632/http://www.putin-itogi.ru/doklad/ |url-status=live }}</ref> ''Putin: What 10 Years of Putin Have Brought'', revised edition of the report ''Putin. Results'' of 2008.<ref>[http://www.putin-itogi.ru/putin-what-10-years-of-putin-have-brought/ Putin: What 10 Years of Putin Have Brought] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150228014558/http://www.putin-itogi.ru/putin-what-10-years-of-putin-have-brought/ |date=28 February 2015 }} 2010. Translated into English. 0Создание сайта: Павел Елизаров.</ref>
*''[[Putin. Corruption]]'' – March 2011. Written by co-chairmen of the [[People's Freedom Party (Russia)|People's Freedom Party]] Nemtsov, Milov, [[Vladimir Ryzhkov|Ryzhkov]] and [[Solidarnost|Solidarity]] movement spokesman Olga Shorina. The printing of the report was funded with donations. Entitled "Putin the Thief", this report stated that Putin's decade in power had seen "an extraordinary increase in the abuse of power and corruption." The report described Putin's corruption in detail and said that it far exceeded "the scale of corruption under Yeltsin." The report stated that [[corruption in Russia]] "has ceased being a problem in Russia; it has become a system" that "represents 25% of the country's GNP."<ref>{{cite web|title=The Nemtsov White Paper, Part V – Putin the Thief|work=La Russophobe|url=https://larussophobe.wordpress.com/2011/04/03/special-extra-the-nemtsov-white-paper-part-v-putin-the-thief|date=3 April 2011|access-date=5 March 2015|archive-date=26 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180826121624/https://larussophobe.wordpress.com/2011/04/03/special-extra-the-nemtsov-white-paper-part-v-putin-the-thief/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*In a May 2013 report, Nemtsov stated that up to $30&nbsp;billion had been stolen from funds allocated for the Sochi Olympics. He accused the Putin administration of cronyism and embezzlement of funds on a level so grand it posed as a threat to Russian national security. He suggested "establishing a civic committee in charge of the investigation of the crimes committed around the Olympic project."<ref name=RFERL/>
*At the time of his murder, Nemtsov was preparing for publication his next report proving the presence of Russian military in eastern Ukraine (BBC News International, 28 February 2015; a Russian source is quoting journalist [[Ksenia Sobchak]] on the matter).<ref name=rosbalt/> In May 2015, the report has been published under the title "[[Putin. War]]".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://openrussia.org/post/view/4803 |title=Путин. Война – Открытая Россия |publisher=Openrussia.org |access-date=30 April 2018 |archive-date=12 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612172052/https://openrussia.org/post/view/4803/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>[http://www.themoscowtimes.com/news/article/nemtsov-report-details-human-and-financial-costs-of-war-in-ukraine/520571.html "Nemtsov Report Details Human and Financial Costs of War in Ukraine"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150514005131/http://www.themoscowtimes.com/news/article/nemtsov-report-details-human-and-financial-costs-of-war-in-ukraine/520571.html |date=14 May 2015 }}, ''Moscow Times'', 12 May 2015.</ref> The publication reported that more than 200 Russian soldiers were then operating in Ukraine.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2015/05/13/world/europe/kremlin-critics-posthumous-report-links-russian-soldiers-to-ukraine.html|title=Kremlin Critic's Posthumous Report Links Russian Soldiers to Ukraine|work=The New York Times|date=12 May 2015|last=Kramer|first=Andrew E.|access-date=26 February 2017|archive-date=22 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180222141542/https://www.nytimes.com/2015/05/13/world/europe/kremlin-critics-posthumous-report-links-russian-soldiers-to-ukraine.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* Nemtsov, Boris. 2000. "Reform for Russia: Forging a New Domestic Policy", ''Harvard International Review'' 22 (No. 2): 16–21.<!-- ISSN/ISBN needed -->
